data.narrative: The student successfully transitioned from raw database operations to a structured Service Layer pattern. They demonstrated advanced production thinking by correctly identifying a subtle logic regression (missing expiration enforcement) and implementing a timezone-aware fix. They also verified the system's resilience under concurrency, confirming that atomic constraints and conflict handling are properly exposed through the API.
